binary_source: 85414a9ca-era aggregate build; relevant tests and production owners unchanged since build
scope: Whole native regression process including fixture creation, load, operations and teardown.3repeats each. These are coarse bounded-workload costs, not latency per callback or frame budgets.
source_confirmation: git diff 85414a9ca HEAD for tests/tests.cpp and tested atlas/audio/attack owners returned empty
allocation_review: ImageSource uses one cached decoded atlas page and allocates logical RGBA output. Successful load moves decoded storage; caller output preserved on failure. Minimap invokes loadContentImage during build, not each frame. Temporary image memory scales with page and logical image area.
Sequential selection uses scalar counter/index and does not grow selectionClicks. Legacy click deque is capped at repeatCount validated2..64. Existing mixer voices/clip resources remain the owner.
AttackTimingState and phase helpers use fixed-size values with no dynamic allocation. Combat uses existing kMaxCadenceShotsPerTick bound per weapon, preventing unbounded sub-tick catch-up.
limitations: Small bounded acceptance workloads, not stress/maximum throughput or isolated per-operation latency.
Whole-process CPU includes startup, allocator/runtime setup, fixtures and shutdown. RSS includes those costs.
GPU not applicable to these CPU owner checks; actual rendering/audio evidence retained separately.
No blanket zero-allocation claim for pack decoding, simulation events or audio mixer.
